content.title: Invincible season 4 release schedule: what time is episode 8 releasing on Prime Video?
content.text: (Image credit: Prime Video) After that explosive seventh episode, which saw Nolan and co. take the fight to Thragg, you're almost certainly wondering when Invincible returns to screens for the season 4 finale. That's where our Invincible season 4 release schedule comes in.Ahead of the final episode of the season, below you'll find everything you need to know about the US and UK streaming release time for Invincible season 4, episode 8, the season 4 episode count, and more.Article continues below Invincible season 4 release date: what time is episode 8 streaming on Prime Video? (Image credit: Prime Video)Invincible season 4, episode 8 will release on April 16 at midnight Pacific/3:00 AM Eastern. That's 8:00 AM GMT in the UK.As it's the final episode of the season, there won't be another episode the following week.Invincible season 4 release schedule: is Amazon dropping all episodes at once? (Image credit: Prime Video)As has become Prime Video tradition in recent years, Invincible season 4 released the first three episodes in one batch, and new episodes will drop weekly.The full Invincible season 4 release schedule looks like this:Invincible season 4, episode 1: March 18 - out now!Invincible season 4, episode 2: March 18 - out now!Invincible season 4, episode 3: March 18 - out now!Invincible season 4, episode 4: March 25 - out now!Invincible season 4, episode 5: April 1 - out now!Invincible season 4, episode 6: April 8 - out now!Invincible season 4, episode 7: April 15 - out now!Invincible season 4, episode 8: April 22Where to watch Invincible season 4 and confirmed episode count (Image credit: Prime Video)Invincible season 4 consists of eight episodes and will be available for all Prime Video subscribers.While you're still doom-scrolling on Prime Video, be sure to check out the best shows on Amazon Prime.
